claim_scope: Consumed-development hard-stratum method selection. This study is outcome-blind to V4 but is not held-out, leaderboard, or population-effect evidence.
exposure_boundary: All 209 EnvBench Dev identities have historical execution evidence as of the 2026-08-30 exposure audit. No case in this study is called unseen.
selection_rule: Use only identities for which the historical cross-method census recorded no Official pass from Codex CLI, EnvSolve-Pro causal-v3, or reproduced Repo2Run.
Exclude a case when its only interpretable non-success evidence is infrastructure or protocol censoring.

Select six cases that cover distinct pre-existing O/C/O failure mechanisms: versioned API action, large optional frontier, monorepo and version frontier, counterexample retention, target bootstrap drift, and Python marker or extras mismatch.
Do not replace a selected identity after observing a V4 algorithm outcome. Infrastructure-only retries preserve arm, case, model, seed, and method.

cases.historical_mechanism: versioned API requirement not mapped to a compatible operation
large explicit optional-integration frontier not realized
monorepo scope plus versioned legacy API frontier
execution counterexamples did not change the active plan
construction and target bootstrap workspace drift
Python target marker and all-extras requirement mismatch

comparison.control: Minimal B with continuous Agent session and repeatedly callable whole-program clean replay
comparison.treatment: V4 with the same session and replay plus operation-linked mutable program and transactional plan edit
comparison.execution: two Spark lanes; both arms of every pair remain on the same host and lane

outcomes.censoring: Infrastructure failures are excluded from algorithm endpoints and may receive only same-arm same-case replacement attempts recorded before the replacement starts.
